fieldValues.title: A flaky e2e test on srs-web main fails unrelated PRs' CI
fieldValues.summary: e2e/agent-library.spec.ts:190 (Guides at 390px) failed CI on main (run 40729530179) and on the 640, 641 and 648-comment-review-fixes branches. The test resized to 390px and counted a 'Go' button before the bar re-rendered narrow, then clicked a vanished button until the 60s timeout. Each failure cost a diagnosis before the PR could be judged.
evidence: fix: wait for header-menu before openMenu, 10/10 repeated runs (srs-web#650)
fieldValues.body:
- Nothing tracks a test that fails on main intermittently, so each PR's driver rediscovers it.
- Suggested change: a red main run on a test that later passes opens a flaky-test bug at once.
